build_grid_ray: build a module that unprojects a 2D pixel grid into rays in rig coordinate systems using a camera batch
build_ray_grid: build a module that generates rays in the rig coordinate system from a single or batched CameraTW object
build_transform_rays: build a module that transforms ray origins and directions from an old coordinate frame to a new one
build_ray_obb_intersection: build a module that computes ray versus oriented bounding box intersection times for a set of rays and voxel extent
build_sample_depths_in_grid: build a module that samples depth values along rays within a voxel grid using random or uniform sampling modes
